businesses.business: managed IoT connectivity and device services

offering_description.value: KORE sells managed cellular connectivity and device deployment services to businesses that build or operate connected products. It combines access to partner mobile networks with SIMs, eSIMs and software that customers use to manage connectivity across their devices.

primary_products.value: IoT SIM cards and eSIMs; connected devices and gateways

primary_services.value: Managed cellular connectivity; connectivity management software; device provisioning and fulfillment; device lifecycle management; IoT integration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Connected device manufacturers, IoT solution providers, fleet technology companies, healthcare technology companies and enterprises managing connected assets

end_markets.value: Fleet and transportation telematics; connected healthcare; industrial IoT; asset tracking and logistics; retail and payments

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring plans for connected devices and access to connectivity management tools; transaction or usage fees: Cellular data and messaging charges based on usage; service fees: Device provisioning, fulfillment, deployment and lifecycle management; product sales: SIM cards, connected devices and gateways supplied for IoT deployments
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Packages connectivity from mobile network operators and manages device deployments for enterprises and IoT solution providers; software / platform: Brings SIM provisioning, network access and usage data into one platform for customers managing connected devices; distributor: Sources connected hardware from device vendors and supplies it to enterprise IoT customers

geography_served.value: global: Multi-carrier coverage across North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: Cellular IoT connectivity, connectivity management software, connected hardware and device lifecycle services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams serving device manufacturers, solution providers and connected asset operators; partners / resellers: IoT solution providers and technology partners that bundle connectivity into their offerings

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Cross-border cellular connectivity and device data handling are subject to local telecom and privacy rules, including the EU GDPR.

notes: The current scope of standalone hardware sales is uncertain.
